$comment: PR1 ships this file as the SCHEMA EXAMPLE only: every eval/weight field
is null/pending because no model has been trained yet. PR2 fills the real
values when the encoder baseline is trained and published. Rule 55
(#1520): no fabricated numbers — the eval block is explicitly empty until
a real run produces it. The committed manifest is the ONLY artifact that
lives in git; datasets, weights, and LLM traces are gitignored.

dataRecipe.$comment: Counts/hash are filled by PR2 from a real generate-data run; PR1 leaves them null because no canonical training dataset is committed (data is gitignored).

eval.$comment: NOT YET RUN. PR2 trains the encoder baseline and fills heldOut (macro/per-class F1); the downstream number comes from the #1574 LoCoMo adversarial-category ablation. Rule 55 forbids fabricating either.

artifact.$comment: Weights publish to the operator's HF account in PR2 (common/hf_push.py); git carries recipes and hashes, never blobs.

policyCompliance.$comment: Issue #1585 policy: target models <=4B for this classification task. 8B LoRA is an escape hatch requiring written justification here.
